topic: Whole-operation DXF write allocation rollback and retry
purpose: Sweep one-shot allocation failures across public dxfRW::write, including setup, LINE/3DFACE/LWPOLYLINE/CIRCLE/IMAGE/MESH/SPLINE/HATCH/LEADER/MLINE/classic POLYLINE/INSERT-ATTRIB compound emission, OBJECTS emission, finalization, generated custom BLOCK/BLOCK_RECORD/INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND plus NOD/GROUP, ACAD_IMAGE_DICT/IMAGEDEF, nested named DICTIONARY/XRECORD/DATALINK dependencies, and output publication.

generatedObjectGraph.groupOutputHandle: remapped and verified through dictionary edge
generatedObjectGraph.memberOutputHandle: remapped LINE handle verified in GROUP membership
generatedObjectGraph.memberOutputHandles: Both remapped LINE and CIRCLE handles verified in GROUP membership
generatedObjectGraph.imageDefinitionOutputHandle: remapped and verified through IMAGE and ACAD_IMAGE_DICT readback
generatedObjectGraph.imageDictionaryPath: NOD[ACAD_IMAGE_DICT] -> IMAGE dictionary -> IMAGEDEF -> IMAGE reference
generatedObjectGraph.namedDictionaryOutputHandle: remapped and verified through root entry
generatedObjectGraph.nestedDictionaryPath: NOD[WHOLE_OPERATION_CUSTOM] -> named DICTIONARY -> XRECORD and three DATALINK records

implementation.productionBehavior: EntityRecordScope now latches writer-local staged-record errors into the enclosing dxfRW operation before record abort restores the local writer error bit. DxfWriterRecordScope also converts commit/materialization exceptions into sticky writer failure. This prevents a failed variable-length entity record from being silently omitted while the document publishes. Custom BLOCK and ENDBLK handles are reserved only for the active write, so failed attempts do not shift retry handles. During whole-file writing, INSERT/ATTRIB caller handles are restored when each compound callback returns; emitted identities remain in the codec map. This avoids retaining borrowed callback records. Standalone writeInsert calls retain their existing successful handle-preserving behavior.
details: Generated MESH output now participates in the whole-operation sweep, including faces, edges, crease values and property overrides.
Generated SPLINE output now participates in the whole-operation sweep with a degree-1 control-point/knot profile and exact typed readback.
Generated patterned HATCH output now participates in the whole-operation sweep with a closed polyline boundary, pattern dash vector and seed point.
Generated LEADER output with three 3D vertices and a nondefault block offset now participates in the whole-operation allocation sweep.
Generated custom BLOCK/BLOCK_RECORD output with one owned POINT and a name-resolved INSERT now participates in the whole-operation sweep.
The INSERT carries one ATTRIB and synthesized SEQEND. Typed readback verifies the block body, INSERT target/name/position and ATTRIB owner/tag/text/position/height.

Whole-file write callbacks restore INSERT/ATTRIB caller handles locally, avoiding a borrowed-pointer journal; standalone writeInsert keeps its handle-preserving behavior. The custom BLOCK/ENDBLK identities remain attempt-scoped.

Generated nonplanar 3DFACE output with four distinct WCS corners and FirstEdge/ThirdEdge invisibility flags now participates in the whole-operation sweep; typed readback verifies all corners and edge flags.
The 3DFACE caller record remains unchanged on failed and successful whole-file writes; same-codec retry reproduces the clean bytes in ASCII and Binary.

procedure.validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j 4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction$ --output-on-failure; build-gcc/tests/libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests /private/tmp/libdxfrw-insert-attrib-borrowed-lifetime-control; cmake --build build-asan-custom --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j 4; ctest --test-dir build-asan-custom -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction$ --output-on-failure
procedure.allocationScope: Global operator-new fault injection is armed only during dxfRW::write. One-time writer/codec setup allocations are warmed before calibrating each encoding. Each failure is one-shot so diagnostic handling and same-codec retry run normally.

result.ctest: Normal 1/1 passed in 1.73 seconds; ASan 1/1 passed in 12.97 seconds.

failureFoundAndFixed.symptom: Injected allocation failure set the staged writer error, but record-scope cleanup restored its prior clear bit; the whole DXF write returned success with the LWPOLYLINE omitted.
failureFoundAndFixed.fix: When EntityRecordScope sees a writer-local failure, it now sets dxfRW::m_writeError before DxfWriterRecordScope cleanup restores the writer’s prior local error bit. The record-scope commit path also latches exceptions during byte materialization or inspection.
failureFoundAndFixed.regression: The new whole-operation allocation sweep reaches this case and requires atomic refusal, unchanged destination/caller state, successful same-codec retry, and complete readback.

currentRun.normalDirectRun: ASCII 357 allocation offsets; Binary 350 allocation offsets; all injected failures preserve destination and caller records, then same-codec retry matches clean bytes and typed readback.
currentRun.threeDFaceReadback: A generated nonplanar 3DFACE has four distinct WCS corners and FirstEdge/ThirdEdge invisibility flags; ASCII/Binary readback confirms all corner coordinates and flags.
currentRun.insertReadback: A generated named BLOCK contains a POINT; a name-resolved INSERT has one ATTRIB and generated SEQEND. ASCII/Binary readback confirms target, owner, tag, text and geometry.
currentRun.allocatorRetryDefect: Injected failure at offset 43 left the next retry with shifted minted handles because BLOCK/ENDBLK reservations persisted. Replacing reserve() with reserveForWrite() restores byte-identical retry.
currentRun.callerHandleRollbackDefect: Injected failure at offset 255 exposed INSERT/ATTRIB handles before later failure. Full-file write callbacks now restore caller handles before returning, while codec identity mappings preserve output references. Standalone writeInsert keeps existing handle mutation semantics.

additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.symptom: Failed custom BLOCK output left its derived BLOCK and ENDBLK handles in the persistent explicit-reservation set; same-codec retry shifted a later VPORT handle and differed from clean output.
additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.fix: Reserve generated BLOCK/ENDBLK handles with reserveForWrite(), which scopes them to the current attempt.
additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.regression: All offsets now require same-codec retry bytes to match the clean output exactly.

additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.symptom: An INSERT with an ATTRIB completed and exposed minted caller handles, then a later allocation failure aborted the full drawing but left those new handles in caller records.
additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.fix: For whole-file writes, restore INSERT and ATTRIB caller handles at the end of the compound callback; rely on the codec identity ledger for later references. This avoids storing borrowed entity pointers beyond callback lifetime. Standalone writeInsert calls retain prior behavior.
additionalFailuresFoundAndFixed.regression: All offsets check original INSERT/ATTRIB and block caller state; successful calibration also confirms caller records remain unchanged. Same-codec retry reproduces exact bytes and typed readback verifies the graph.

limits: This generated transaction control exercises LINE, nonplanar 3DFACE with selected invisible edges, variable-length LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, IMAGE, MESH vertices/faces/edges/creases/property overrides, degree-1 SPLINE control points/knots, patterned HATCH boundary/pattern/seed data, three-point LEADER and block offset, MLINE with a referenced MLINESTYLE and nested per-vertex segment/area-fill parameters, classic POLYLINE with two owned VERTEX records and SEQEND, custom BLOCK/BLOCK_RECORD containing POINT, name-resolved INSERT with ATTRIB/SEQEND, IMAGEDEF, raw XRECORD, three DATALINK records with two custom target references, and rooted NOD/GROUP, ACAD_IMAGE_DICT, and named-DICTIONARY graphs; it is not exhaustive coverage of every whole-drawing allocation path, record family, platform, or filesystem failure mode.
Same-library typed readback and byte-identical retry establish transaction behavior only, not independent interoperability or format-support claims.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed. Generated output is created in the test scratch directory and removed after each encoding.
